Methods Overview

A summary of the indicators and analytic approach used throughout this dashboard, ahead of the country-level sections below.

01

Indicators Assessed

  • ANC4+
  • Fever care seeking
  • Facility delivery
  • First birth < 20
  • Zero-dose
  • Malaria RDT+*
  • Anemia (women)
  • Wasting

* Malaria RDT+ not available for Ethiopia
